name: rafi-cloudflare
description: Rafi on Cloudflare Workers: one installation's deployment

RAFI_PUBLIC_URL.description: The public origin of this installation, without a trailing slash: `https://raffle.example.org`. QR codes and links use it; Clerk must allow it.

RAFI_ENGINE_API_KEY.description: A Restate Cloud API key for that environment with ingress access.

RAFI_RESTATE_ENDPOINT__IDENTITY_KEYS.description: The Restate environment's public key(s), `publickeyv1_…`, comma separated: the Worker verifies that the engine's requests are Restate's.

RAFI_ALTCHA_KEY.description: The proof-of-work key, random and at least 32 characters: `openssl rand -hex 32`. Never rotate it during an event.

CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Your Clerk application's publishable key, `pk_live_…`. Not a secret: the web app signs organizers in with it.

RAFI_OPERATOR_NAME.description: Who runs this installation (a legal name), named as the processor in every raffle's privacy notice.

RAFI_OPERATOR_EMAIL.description: The operator's contact for privacy matters.

RAFI_TERMS_VERSION.description: The version of `legal/terms.md`, e.g. `2026-10`. A changed document is a new version.
